# LA Clippers Fantasy Basketball Preview [26/27 NBA Season]

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-10-04, 35:22. https://youtu.be/tnzmsYUA4yQ

## Summary

Josh Lloyd previews the LA Clippers for fantasy basketball. He calls the team a mess with unclear motivation: they have no control over their own draft pick, they lack future picks and four rotation players are injured. His projected starting five is Darius Garland, Max Strus, Derrick Jones Jr., Rui Hachimura and Isaiah Jackson, with Kris Dunn, Bradley Beal, Brook Lopez, Keaton Wagler and Kobe Sanders off the bench. Garland is his best target on the team, Brandon Ingram (partially torn Achilles) is the biggest fade, and Isaiah Jackson is the late-round swing. He also likes Strus and Hachimura as possible late picks. He is low on the rookie Wagler and on Lopez, and he sees Yanic Konan Niederhauser as a possible starting center later in the season once he returns from his foot injury.
